name: Kit Issue
description: Three optional checks at the stores counter.

checks.name: Talk Nobu out of something extra

outcomes.criticalSuccess: He stops writing, looks at them properly for the first time, and goes into the back. Everyone in Section Nine gets something extra.
outcomes.success: "...Fine. Quickly." That player gets something extra.
outcomes.criticalFailure: He loudly assumes they're after a second weapon, and won't be worked again today.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: It sits right first time, and Nobu notices mid-sentence and says so.
outcomes.failure: A strap on backwards. Somebody helps.
outcomes.criticalFailure: Comically tangled, and everyone politely ignores it.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: As success, and the stamp names a chandler on the old town's waterfront, with a price pencilled beside it in Nobu's own hand.
outcomes.success: Under the fresh Directorate paint is a ships' chandler's stamp. This didn't come out of Directorate stores.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They decide it's old navy surplus, repainted, and tell anyone who asks.

notes: None of the three checks costs anything mechanical.
